animation.idle: No global glow. Ruby inlay nearly dormant.
animation.reveal: Specular sweep traverses chassis, then ruby inlay ignites left-to-right.
animation.scroll: Use camera/light movement on future extruded GLB; SVG fallback may translate a masked highlight.
animation.active: Ruby energy may travel only inside ruby-inlay paths.

3dConversion.note: Extrude chassis and ruby-inlay as separate meshes so materials and emissive animation remain independent.
